EntryMethod: Natural engine acceleration in Road mode; then selected assist and 350 ms pedal preconditioning. No moving velocity/yaw assignment.
AcceptanceScope: Entry speed, full authored steering, prompt centering, finite physics, combined tire force envelope, plus stable sub-peak 0.3g gentle turns. Sharp cases have no universal rear-spin or stability expectation.
SlidingDefinition: At least one grounded axle wheel with >20 N normal load and WheelTelemetry.IsSliding at each 60 Hz observation. Continuous durations are consecutive observations.
MechanicalVariantLimitation: Current authoring shares tire and suspension across axles; no rear-only grip or roll-bias variant is fabricated.
